scope: Sales-only. Three Serra Sales profiles. Six native VinSolutions families. 18 cells. M1R readiness is false for every cell in this pass; later gates must satisfy every requirement.
weekly_freshness_policy: weekly_native: period == most-recently completed Mon-Sun week at evaluation; period-end age <= 8 calendar days; scheduler receipt/capture <= 72h after period end (all three mandatory)
daily_freshness_policy: daily_comm: period == immediately preceding completed local calendar day; exact one-day window; scheduler receipt/capture <= 36h after period end; evaluation age <= 2 calendar days; No gap may be relabeled current.

appointments.freshness_policy: weekly_native: period == most-recently completed Mon-Sun week at evaluation; period-end age <= 8 calendar days; scheduler receipt/capture <= 72h after period end (all three mandatory)
appointments.provenance_envelope: gmail_scheduler requires sender+subject+gmail_message_id; period_hint range required
appointments.sales_proof: Appt Reason == 'Sales Appointment' on every row; Appointment Type scanned for Service/Parts
appointments.dealer_proof_template: every Dealer ID == {DEALER_ID}; unique Appointment ID; Start Date + Start DateTime within period_hint
appointments.metric_calculation_coverage: appt.show_rate, appt.no_show_rate, appt.confirmed_rate, appt.cancel_rate (isolated adds appt.reschedule_rate)

dealership_performance.freshness_policy: weekly_native: period == most-recently completed Mon-Sun week at evaluation; period-end age <= 8 calendar days; scheduler receipt/capture <= 72h after period end (all three mandatory)
dealership_performance.provenance_envelope: gmail_scheduler requires sender+subject+gmail_message_id; period from Filters range
dealership_performance.native_format: XLSX multi-section (Dealership Summary + Lead Type & Inventory Type Summary) + Filters sheet
dealership_performance.sales_proof: Filters Lead Type == {Internet,Phone,Walk-in}; no positive Service/Parts
dealership_performance.dealer_proof_template: Filters exactly one Dealers value matching {DEALER_NAME} {DEALER_ID}
dealership_performance.transformation_boundary: classify-only; every non-blank row preserved generically; bytes immutable
dealership_performance.metric_calculation_coverage: gross.total_sum (from TOTAL summary.totalGross); native dp summary. roi.* NOT derived here (Dashboard vs Lead Source ROI definition divergence)

lead_source_roi.freshness_policy: weekly_native: period == most-recently completed Mon-Sun week at evaluation; period-end age <= 8 calendar days; scheduler receipt/capture <= 72h after period end (all three mandatory)
lead_source_roi.provenance_envelope: gmail_scheduler requires sender+subject+gmail_message_id; period from Filters range
lead_source_roi.native_format: XLSX data sheet + Filters sheet; ROI/CAGE CSV quarantine-only
lead_source_roi.sales_proof: Filters Base Report Name == Lead Source ROI; Lead Type == governed eight; Lead Intent must NOT positively select Service/Parts; Lead Source scanned for service/parts
lead_source_roi.dealer_proof_template: Filters exactly one Dealers value (no Dealer column in rows) matching {DEALER_ID}
lead_source_roi.transformation_boundary: classify-only; native spaced headers; ROI/CAGE CSV quarantine-only (cannot be promoted)
lead_source_roi.reader_status: isolated roiMetrics only; NOT wired in hs-watchdog Halo path (MISSING reader)
lead_source_roi.metric_calculation_coverage: roi.total_leads, roi.sold_from_leads, roi.duplicate_rate (isolated adds roi.actual_roi) — WITHHELD

cage_kpi.freshness_policy: weekly_native: period == most-recently completed Mon-Sun week at evaluation; period-end age <= 8 calendar days; scheduler receipt/capture <= 72h after period end (all three mandatory)
cage_kpi.provenance_envelope: gmail_scheduler requires sender+subject+gmail_message_id; period from Filters range
cage_kpi.native_format: XLSX data sheet + Filters sheet; ROI/CAGE CSV quarantine-only
cage_kpi.sales_proof: Filters Base Report Name == Enterprise Performance; Lead Type == {Internet,Phone,Walk-in}; no positive Service/Parts
cage_kpi.dealer_proof_template: every non-total row Dealer == {DEALER_NAME} {DEALER_ID}; narrow last-row TOTAL exemption
cage_kpi.transformation_boundary: classify-only; ROI/CAGE CSV quarantine-only (cannot be promoted)
cage_kpi.reader_status: isolated cageMetrics only; NOT wired in hs-watchdog Halo path (MISSING reader)

sales_comm_log.expected_period_policy: immediately preceding completed local calendar day (exact one-day window)
sales_comm_log.freshness_policy: daily_comm: period == immediately preceding completed local calendar day; exact one-day window; scheduler receipt/capture <= 36h after period end; evaluation age <= 2 calendar days; No gap may be relabeled current.
sales_comm_log.provenance_envelope: gmail_scheduler requires sender+subject+gmail_message_id; period_hint single day
sales_comm_log.native_format: XLSX single daily data sheet (Filters optional)
sales_comm_log.sales_proof: Lead Type, Lead Status Type, Lead Source scanned for Service/Parts; contaminated saved Filters quarantines
sales_comm_log.transformation_boundary: classify-only; Message Content hashed never stored; bytes immutable
sales_comm_log.reader_status: isolated commMetrics only; NOT wired in hs-watchdog Halo path (MISSING reader)
sales_comm_log.metric_calculation_coverage: comm.escalation_keyword_screen, comm.template_overuse, comm.inbound_high_intent_keywords, comm.multi_rep_within_24h (isolated adds comm.outbound_link_only) — WITHHELD. Stable-ID gap blocks ordered-thread/causal metrics only, not every safe provisional single-row metric

crm_sales_gross.expected_period_policy: most-recently completed Mon-Sun week (coverage window via period_hint)
crm_sales_gross.freshness_policy: weekly_native: period == most-recently completed Mon-Sun week at evaluation; period-end age <= 8 calendar days; scheduler receipt/capture <= 72h after period end (all three mandatory)
crm_sales_gross.provenance_envelope: gmail_scheduler requires sender+subject+gmail_message_id; coverage period_hint range required
crm_sales_gross.sales_proof: per-deal rows; every Dealer matches target (no Service/Parts commingling)
crm_sales_gross.dealer_proof_template: every Dealer ID populated == {DEALER_ID}; rows spanning dealers quarantine
crm_sales_gross.reader_status: isolated grossMetrics only (computes gross.total_sum + gross.reconciliation_mismatches from per-deal rows); hs-watchdog derives ONLY gross.total_sum from Dashboard TOTAL (split gross); per-deal reconciliation reader MISSING
crm_sales_gross.metric_calculation_coverage: gross.total_sum + gross.reconciliation_mismatches (per-deal) — WITHHELD. Split gross reconciliation requires CRM Sales Gross, not Dashboard alone
